annotations.title: Score my résumé against a job

description: Score the candidate's résumé against one job: match percentage, per-dimension scores, the reason and the skills they are missing. Give exactly one of job_id, application_id or job_description. Job pages are not fetched here: for a posting outside the catalog, read it yourself and pass its text as job_description. An AI model scores it (Anthropic's Claude, with DeepSeek through OpenRouter as the fallback). Uses their monthly AI allowance, and a score for a catalog job is saved on their board. Rewriting the résumé is not done here: tailor_url opens that on TrueInterview.

job_description.description: The posting's text, for a job outside the catalog.

job_id.description: An id from search_jobs or recommend_jobs.

name: match_resume_to_job
